title: Finite composition in the colimit precoverage
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a strict diagram $F:J\to\mathit{Cat}$, and $P_j$ precoverages on its stages. Assume each $P_j$ contains singleton isomorphisms, is stable under finite indexed composition and finite indexed base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and has pullbacks of its covering arrows. Every covering presieve has finite uncurried arrow set. Every transition functor maps covering presieves to covering presieves and preserves the pullback of a covering arrow along any arrow. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on its vertex. Assume a presieve $R$ on $Y$ belongs to $Q$ exactly when there are a stage $j$, an object $X$, a covering $S$ of $P_j$ on $X$, and an equality $V_j(X)=Y$ such that transport of $S.map(V_j)$ along that equality is $R$. Then $Q$ is stable under composition of finite indexed covering families, with finite inner index at each outer index.

proof.text: Lift the outer family and all inner families simultaneously, retaining their index types, stage covering properties, and equal image arrows.
Apply the finite indexed composition axiom of P_j to the lifted covering families.

Functoriality of composition and the equalities of image arrows identify each lifted composite with its requested composite. Presieve.map_ofArrows identifies the mapped composite presieve; transport along the target equality handles empty families as well. Use the reverse implication of hQ to conclude covering in Q.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL, verification of axiom (2); D3 second reader formalized stage composition and presieve-image transport, leaving only simultaneous input-family lifting open.

theorem colimit_site_covering_axioms_FiniteComposition
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition
